title: Define Zod schemas for all AI pipeline outputs
description: Create Zod schemas in src/lib/ai/schemas.ts for all three AI pipeline generateObject calls: the condensation schema (condensed business profile), the structure decision schema (section list + metadata), and the content generation schema (all section content). These schemas replace manual JSON parsing and provide automatic validation.
acceptanceCriteria: All schemas are valid Zod schemas usable with AI SDK `generateObject`
`structureSchema` validates: sections array (type + variant + reasoning), tone, paletteHint
`contentSchema` validates all content fields for all 21 section types
`condensationSchema` validates the condensed business profile fields
TypeScript infers correct types from all schemas

steps.details:
```ts
import { z } from 'zod';
export const condensationSchema = z.object({
  businessName: z.string(),
  phones: z.array(z.string()),
  emails: z.array(z.string()),
  address: z.string().optional(),
  services: z.array(z.string()),
  testimonials: z.array(z.string()),
  uniquePoints: z.array(z.string()),
  yearsInBusiness: z.number().optional(),
  summary: z.string(),
});
```

Define a Zod schema for each of the 21 section content types. Mirror the TypeScript interfaces from TASK-16. Use `z.string()`, `z.array()`, `z.object()`, `.optional()` as appropriate. Create a discriminated union schema for all section content keyed by section type.

Export inferred types: `export type CondensedProfile = z.infer<typeof condensationSchema>`, `export type StructureDecision = z.infer<typeof structureSchema>`. These are used as the typed return values of the AI pipeline functions.

technicalNotes: The contentSchema for the full content generation call is the most complex. Consider defining it as a Zod object where each key corresponds to a section type: `z.object({ hero: heroContentSchema, services: servicesContentSchema, ... })`.
Use `.describe()` on Zod fields to give the AI better hints about what each field should contain.
The AI SDK's generateObject uses the Zod schema to validate the AI response and retry automatically if validation fails.
Make all fields in content schemas .optional() to be lenient — the AI may not always fill in every field.
